coverage: Broad but PARTIAL historic British and SAIC-era production catalogue. Selected European tables are not exhaustive.
gaps: All version tables remain partial: selected MG3Hybrid+,MG4,ZS EV,ZS Hybrid+,HS II,Cyberster and TF2002 only.
Historic roadsters and saloons have sourced identities but mostly no technical tables. T-type and Magnette generation sequences are separated; subsidiary body/engine combinations remain incomplete.
MG3II,MG5EV,HSI,MG6,MG7,ZR,ZT,MGF,RV8 and historic MGB/MGA/Midget versions need later primary-brochure work.

Global regional programme remains partial: MG8,MGU9,G50,Maxus7/9,Binguo,VS,Whale,RX5/RX8 and some recent2026 badge families not yet independently reconciled. Upcoming/concept-only entries were not imported.
MG3SW is separated from later MG3 generations; TF2002/2005–2007 gap is retained. HistoricTF1953 is underT-type. Rover-eraZS has its own zs-2001 identity.
MG5 combustion and MG5EV estate remain separate; donor Roewei5 dates are not substituted for regionally badgedMG5. MG4Urban existingidentity retained with unresolved badge chronology.
MagnetteIV1968/1969 end disagreement leftnull. No blanket current-production claim for undated badge variants.
January2025 HS sheet contains draft price placeholders, so no specifications were imported from it. Final June2026 Croatian HSICE table is scoped separately.
Electric Wh/km values and rounded litre labels were not converted. CVT simulated steps are not gear counts. MG3 143kW and ZSHybrid145kW are system outputs, not arithmetic sums.
Photo search bounded, not exhausted. TD side-profile fallback explicitly labelled; Midget museum photo has a thin display barrier in the foreground; remaining photosnull.
excluded: Race-only Q/R/C/18-100 Tigress, EX record cars, one-off OldNumberOne and concepts excluded.
Unconfirmed upcoming production models not added from announcements.

photoSearch.method: Commons categories/subcategories, paced imageinfo API with exact per-file author/licence; accepted photos individually inspected. No marketplace assets.

validation.checks: Unique production identities, scoped versions, exact Commons credits/aspects, indexed nulls and retained conflicts.

cleanup.retained: Structured facts and exact metadata; no downloaded documents, extracted full texts or image previews.
